mapper.sql: workspace_id, version_id, req_id, audience, support_contact, options, narratives, confirmed, acceptance, updated_by, revision, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM delivery_note WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND version_id = #{versionId}
SELECT FROM delivery_note WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND version_id = #{versionId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO delivery_note (workspace_id, version_id, req_id, audience, support_contact, options, narratives, confirmed, acceptance, updated_by, revision) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{versionId}, #{reqId}, #{audience}, #{supportContact}, #{options}, #{narratives}, #{confirmed}, #{acceptance}, #{updatedBy}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE req_id = VALUES(req_id), audience = VALUES(audience), support_contact = VALUES(support_contact), options = VALUES(options), narratives = VALUES(narratives), confirmed = VALUES(confirmed), acceptance = VALUES(acceptance), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), revision = revision + 1

INSERT INTO delivery_note_snapshot (id, workspace_id, version_id, req_id, release_id, seq, doc_no, tone, title, payload, content_hash, created_by, created_by_name) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{versionId}, #{reqId}, #{releaseId}, #{seq}, #{docNo}, #{tone}, #{title}, #{payload}, #{contentHash}, #{createdBy}, #{createdByName})
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, version_id, req_id, release_id, seq, doc_no, tone, title, content_hash, created_by, created_by_name, created_at FROM delivery_note_snapshot WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY seq DESC
SELECT MAX(seq) FROM delivery_note_snapshot WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND version_id = #{versionId}
SELECT workspace_id, snapshot_id, token, allow_download, view_count, created_at, expires_at FROM delivery_note_share WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND snapshot_id = #{snapshotId}
SELECT workspace_id, snapshot_id, token, allow_download, view_count, created_at, expires_at FROM delivery_note_share WHERE token = #{token}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO delivery_note_share (workspace_id, snapshot_id, token, allow_download, expires_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{snapshotId}, #{token}, #{allowDownload}, #{expiresAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE token = VALUES(token), allow_download = VALUES(allow_download), expires_at = VALUES(expires_at), created_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM delivery_note_share WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND snapshot_id = #{snapshotId}
mapper.update: UPDATE delivery_note_share SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND snapshot_id = #{snapshotId}
